observations.description: No network/credential/live/scheduler imports. Only dataclass, datetime, decimal, enum, hashlib, json, paper_gateway_v2 used. trading_authority=False in adapter, receipts, commands.

Command construction: exactly one of submission or event required (XOR), both reject, neither reject. command_id and expected_gateway_snapshot_id must be lowercase SHA-256. trading_authority=True rejects.
Snapshot binding: expected_gateway_snapshot_id must match current gateway snapshot_id. Stale/fabricated reject with STALE_GATEWAY_SNAPSHOT. No receipt recorded, no gateway mutation.

Command idempotency: exact retry returns IDEMPOTENT_REPLAY without creating another order. Reusing command_id with different fingerprint → COMMAND_CONFLICT without mutation. Rejected commands remain idempotent after conditions change.
Duplicate-order: different command IDs with same V2 order identity → GATEWAY_REJECTED with DUPLICATE_CONFLICT. No exposure or open-order count increase.

Order events: fill/cancel snapshot-bound, exact event replay idempotent, conflicting event fingerprint → COMMAND_CONFLICT, stale version/overfill/time regression/unknown order/terminal all reject via gateway. Quantity conservation preserved.
Disconnect: produces connected=false, reconciliation_required=true. Submission blocked while disconnected. Repeated disconnect deterministic. Disconnect cannot clear kill switch.

Reconciliation: bound to expected_gateway_snapshot_id, exact observation required (paper_order_id, state, filled, remaining, version), mismatch → RECONCILIATION_MISMATCH + kill_switch + disconnected, only exact restores connectivity, cannot clear kill switch, never grants trading authority.
Receipts: frozen dataclass, all IDs are SHA-256, before/after snapshot lineage exact, gateway reason preserved, ordering deterministic (appended), tampered adapter_id rejects via verify_integrity.

Adapter integrity: adapter_id=canonical(gateway.snapshot_id, receipts, false), tamper rejects, receipt reordering rejects (unique command_ids), duplicate command IDs reject, corrupted gateway rejects (PaperGatewaySnapshotV1.resume), replay identical.
Failure injection: command fingerprint failure (ValueError at construction) no partial mutation, integrity failure before execution, no false acceptance on gateway rejection.
Implementation coupling: imports only paper_gateway_v2 public contracts. No direct execution_accounting_v2 coupling (contracts re-exported). Adversarial tests use only public API.

accepted_after_correction: test_mismatch_keeps_disconnected (corrected: empty adapter with no records → reconcile with empty matches; need a record + wrong observation to trigger mismatch)
test_command_fingerprint_failure_no_partial_mutation (corrected: replace with invalid command_id raises ValueError at construction, not at execute)
